Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation sprite sheet for actual downloadable chat stickers.
Create ONE perfectly regular 4 columns x 4 rows sprite sheet, 16 equally sized square cells. Transparent background, true alpha, no grid lines, no margins between cells. Total image square, ideally 2048x2048. Each ROW is a different small action with 4 consecutive animation frames left to right. All four frames of one row must show the SAME character in the SAME exact scale, camera, feet/center anchor and position, changing only the specified action slightly. Each cell has comfortable empty padding of at least 12% so character and props never touch boundaries. Draw ONE isolated complete vignette in each cell. No lettering, no words, no labels, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no watermark anywhere; readable Chinese captions will be added separately. Production quality professional messaging stickers: original appealing chibi characters, expressive readable silhouette at 240px, confident warm charcoal outlines, soft gouache-like smooth shading, little tactile texture, warm friendly palette, white 5px die-cut outer edge. The four frames should be genuinely distinct motion keyframes, NOT four copies, while anatomy and identity stay stable. Do not add backgrounds or scenery. Do not duplicate limbs. Cell order is exact. ONE ORIGINAL PET CHARACTER: plump orange tabby cat called Milkcap, three dark orange forehead stripes, white muzzle and belly, short rounded ears with a tiny V notch on the cat's left ear, teal triangular bandanna, four short paws, striped tail. Its defining features, coat and bandanna match in every frame.
Row 1, ACKNOWLEDGED: cat holds one front paw in a thumbs-up-like soft paw gesture; frame1 attentive upright ears; frame2 slight downward head nod and eyes happily narrow; frame3 lowest nod with tiny golden sparkle beside paw; frame4 returning to frame1. All other body parts stationary.
Row 2, AFFECTION: cat hugs one small coral heart against chest; frame1 eyes open and heart close; frame2 closes eyes and squeezes heart slightly; frame3 happy cheeks and heart lifted 5%; frame4 release to frame1. Body anchored.
Row 3, MEALTIME: cat sits behind one small cream food bowl with kibble; frame1 looking at bowl expectantly; frame2 ears perk, mouth little excited smile; frame3 gently lifts one paw to invite with two tiny golden excitement marks; frame4 paw lowers, returns to frame1. Bowl stays fixed.
Row 4, GOOD NIGHT: cat curls on its own striped tail with tiny crescent moon above; frame1 sleepy half-open eyes; frame2 eyes close; frame3 relaxed breathing belly slightly expands; frame4 belly relaxes to frame1. Moon fixed. Keep the cat entirely inside each cell.

TWO ORIGINAL ADULT HUMAN CHIBI CHARACTERS with warm natural skin tones: adult woman with black chin-length bob hair, peach cardigan over cream shirt, dark skirt; adult man with chestnut soft wavy hair, dark teal sweater, cream trousers. Both clearly young adults, tiny body proportions for stickers. Identity, hair, clothes and relative scale must match in all 16 cells. No extra people.
Row 1, HUG: couple stands side by side and embraces; frame1 gently leaning together arms around shoulders; frame2 heads touch and eyes close; frame3 squeezes a little closer with one tiny coral heart above; frame4 relaxes to frame1. Both sets of feet stay anchored.
Row 2, MISS YOU: woman sitting holding a cream pillow with tiny coral heart symbol; man represented only as a tiny simple head-shaped thought vignette beside her, stable position; frame1 thoughtful open eyes; frame2 looking toward vignette; frame3 cheeks blush and smiles gently; frame4 returns to frame1. This is one vignette, not a separate grid.
Row 3, HOME SAFELY: adult man alone at a small minimalist doorway, no scenery; he holds a small teal phone at chest height and raises free hand; frame1 smiling; frame2 begins gentle wave; frame3 palm tilted other way with a tiny gold glint near phone; frame4 free hand returns. Doorway static, no letters.
Row 4, DAILY LOVE: both adult characters standing facing viewer, together making one heart with their hands; frame1 eyes open and soft smile; frame2 eyes close and cheeks warm; frame3 heads tilt slightly toward each other and tiny heart above glows; frame4 return. Consistent hand anatomy and no extra fingers. All vignettes fully inside each cell.

ONE ORIGINAL SMALL BAKERY MASCOT: a thick soft slice of toasted bread, rounded square shape, caramel crust, cream crumb face, two dark oval eyes, little coral cheeks, tiny stubby bread arms and legs, forest-green apron with single cream button. The silhouette, apron, eyes and crust thickness stay exactly consistent in every frame. Very charming professionally designed original IP; not a brand logo.
Row 1, ORDER RECEIVED: toast mascot holds a cream order slip with no writing, front facing. Frame1 attentive; frame2 small nod with eyes narrowing; frame3 lifts one paw to cheerful OK gesture and a small golden checkmark-shaped sparkle; frame4 returns. Order slip and body anchored.
Row 2, PACKING: mascot behind a small unbranded kraft pastry box, box positioned fixed at bottom. Frame1 paws on open box flaps; frame2 gently lowers one flap; frame3 closes the lid with delighted eyes and little sparkle; frame4 lid opens slightly to loop. No missing or extra arms. Frame content remains same layout.
Row 3, THANK YOU: mascot holds small coral heart at chest, frame1 upright; frame2 begins polite bow; frame3 shallow bow eyes closed, tiny two sparkles; frame4 rises to upright. Feet anchored and heart size unchanged.
Row 4, SEE YOU TOMORROW: mascot holding a small empty cream shop sign with no writing in one paw, other paw waves. Frame1 smile, hand raised; frame2 hand angled outward; frame3 hand angled inward and one star sparkles; frame4 returns. All vignettes fully inside each cell.
